evidence.detail: ONE request carried 20 aliased copies of a field and the server executed every alias (20/20 present in the response). A per-request rate limit counts 1 request while the server performs 20 units of resolver work — the aliasing cost-DoS surface. Distinct from batching (array of operations) and covered by CWE-400 resource-consumption guidance.

result: FINDING produced on the vulnerable fixture
